profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
Software engineer based in New York. 

Link to Github: https://github.com/jungholee27

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead reusability efforts on our application, which helped save developer time and introduced more maintainable code. This influenced many other engineers to follow suit.
- Designed infrastructure changes to save cost which ultimately saved 25% of our cloud costs.
- Drove the efforts to improve performance on our application's main workflow which consisted of 90% of our queries. This included tuning our MySQL Database, refactoring code and changing previously implemented patterns such as going from REST to WS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Closely worked with the infrastructure of the application where I lead several production support calls which included tearing down and bringing up infrastructure as a whole.
- Refactored legacy code including the following languages: Javascript/Typescript, Java, Python, Angular and MySQL (SQL) which helped developer time to deliver by applying best practices for reusability and maintainability.
- Quickly adapted to proprietary applications where I was considered an SME on our CICD pipeline, vulnerability reporting tools, and many others.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed with React components implementing algorithms which parse drag and drop queries into PromQL under the hood for fast rendering speeds to the application to create simpler ways to use PromQL as it is considered to have a steep learning curve, making it more accessible for engineers.  
• Built the backend, using Express.js for quick requests and scalability to handle large amounts of requests, and also to handle storage using a local database for users to save their data, including past queries and settings.
• Implemented the application with Electron for its cross-platform accessibility, security handling of sensitive data such as Kubernetes cluster information, and ability to push out regular updates to users for additional functionality and bug fixes.
• Utilized TDD using Jest for PromQL algorithms testing, Enzyme for frontend rendering, and Supertest for backend integration testing to ensure functionality, stability, and usability for the application.
• Tested with applications deployed using Kubernetes and Docker, which are containerization technologies most monitored with Prometheus, to ensure that the application is compatible with each deployment strategy.
• Worked with a team using a scrum board, having multiple stand ups throughout the day to manage each team member’s time which assured a balance between team members while also creating a timeline of the product.
• Utilized TravisCI to deploy the application’s landing page and application to affirm all tests are passing on TravisCI’s virtual machine and implementing CI/CD into our platform for deploying and updating our EC2 instance on AWS.
• Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs.

positions.title: Weathercation | Road trip planner for displaying weather info based on address
positions.description:
• Utilized React and React-Router to implement a virtual DOM to ensure fast render speeds and to create static routes to build a SPA to optimize load performance and user experience by shifting to a client-side rendering pattern which minimized calls to the server through React-Router.
• Designed an API using Express.js with a NoSQL Database to authenticate users and to persist data which the user inputted in a previous date, using a NoSQL database for faster lookup speeds since the application was made for single users.
• Integrated RESTful APIs, for its flexibility to be integrated, to collect essential data using GoogleAPI for location and OpenWeatherAPI for temperature and conditions.

positions.title: One Number | All in one finance application to view liabilities, assets, and holdings in real time
positions.description:
• Used React to create functional components with React Hooks, to incorporate Flux architecture for this SPA, using various packages to build out graphs and charts, such as React-Bootstrap, for better visualization of data while accompanied with number values.
• Implemented Express with MongoDB using Google OAuth as a primary form of authentication, Plaid API as a secondary form, to ensure security and create sessions for users using cookies.
• Applied Webpack to minify and uglify Javascript code for faster execution and lower space taken for the application, using babel to transpile ES6 and JSX into ES5 for browsers to compile.

positions.title: Substance Use Disorder Treatment Planning | Treatment journal for recovering SUD patients and doctor
positions.description:
• Integrated a PostgresQL database for ACID compliance data architecture to allow authenticated users to have consistent data when viewing a user’s journal by storing relational data separately from users.
• Injected B-crypt and salt rounds in Express controllers to securely verify users by hashing passwords and identifying authorization levels to provide additional authorization control to the system's database.
